answer_1.quote: We illustrate an example of our framework ... generate responses using the collected evidence via reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF). ... our RARG generates polite and factual responses that clearly refutes input misinformation.

answer_2.quote: We follow the evaluation from using metrics refutation (R.), factuality (F.) and politeness (P.), we also evaluate the response relevance to input claim (C.) and evidence (E.) using our dense retriever. ... Retrieval metrics include NDCG and Recall (N@k, R@k).
